symbol.name: checkoutOrder
symbol.content: export function checkoutOrder(input: OrderInput): SavedOrder {   const subtotal = calculateSubtotal(input.items);   const discount = applyDiscount(subtotal, input.coupon);   const shipping = calculateShipping(input.items, input.customer.region);   reserveStock(input.items);   return saveOrder(input.customer.id, {     subtotal, discount, shipping, total: subtotal - discount + shipping,   }); }

symbol.name: validate
symbol.content: export function validate(customer: Customer): void {   if (!customer.id.trim()) throw new Error("Customer id is required"); }

symbol.name: applyDiscount
symbol.content: export function applyDiscount(subtotal: number, coupon?: string): number {   return coupon === "SAVE10" ? Math.floor(subtotal * 0.1) : 0; }

symbol.name: estimateOrder
symbol.content: export function estimateOrder(input: OrderInput): Quote {   const subtotal = calculateSubtotal(input.items);   const discount = applyDiscount(subtotal, input.coupon);   const shipping = shippingCost(input.items, input.customer.region);   return { subtotal, discount, shipping, total: subtotal - discount + shipping }; }

symbol.name: validate
symbol.content: export function validate(items: CartItem[]): void {   if (!items.length || items.some(item => item.quantity < 1)) {     throw new Error("Cart must contain positive quantities");   } }

symbol.name: reserveStock
symbol.content: export function reserveStock(items: CartItem[]): number {   validate(items);   return items.reduce((quantity, item) => quantity + item.quantity, 0); }

symbol.name: calculateSubtotal
symbol.content: export function calculateSubtotal(items: CartItem[]): number {   return items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity * item.unitPrice, 0); }

symbol.name: calculateShipping
symbol.content: export function calculateShipping(items: CartItem[], region: Customer["region"]): number {   const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.unitPrice * item.quantity, 0);   if (subtotal >= 10000 && region === "local") return 0;   const weight = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.weight * item.quantity, 0);   return (region === "remote" ? 1200 : 500) + Math.max(0, Math.ceil(weight) - 1) * 200; }

symbol.name: saveOrder
symbol.content: export function saveOrder(customerId: string, quote: Quote): SavedOrder {   return { id: `demo-${customerId}`, customerId, status: "confirmed", ...quote }; }

definitions.name: cases
definitions.content: const cases = [   { name: "local-discount", input, expected: 5900 },   { name: "remote-shipping", input: { ...input, customer: { id: "buyer-02", region: "remote" as const } }, expected: 6600 },   { name: "free-shipping", input: { ...input, items: [{ sku: "DESK", quantity: 1, unitPrice: 12000, weight: 3 }] }, expected: 10800 }, ];

definitions.name: results
definitions.content: const results = cases.map(test => {   const quote = estimateOrder(test.input);   const order = submitOrder(test.input);   assert.equal(order.total, test.expected);   assert.equal(quote.total, order.total);   return { name: test.name, passed: true, total: order.total, quoteMatchesCheckout: true }; });

definitions.name: verify.ts
definitions.content: import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { submitOrder } from "./routes/order.ts"; import { estimateOrder } from "./services/estimate.ts"; import type { OrderInput } from "./types.ts"; const input: OrderInput = {   customer: { id: "buyer-01", region: "local" },   items: [{ sku: "BOOK", quantity: 2, unitPrice: 3000, weight: 0.5 }],   coupon: "SAVE10", }; const cases = [   { name: "local-discount", input, expected: 5900 },   { name: "remote-shipping", input: { ...input, customer: { id: "buyer-02", region: "remote" as const } }, expected: 6600 },   { name: "free-shipping", input: { ...input, items: [{ sku: "DESK", quantity: 1, unitPrice: 12000, weight: 3 }] }, expected: 10800 }, ]; const results = cases.map(test => {   const quote = estimateOrder(test.input);   const order = submitOrder(test.input);   assert.equal(order.total, test.expected);   assert.equal(quote.total, order.total);   return { name: test.name, passed: true, total: order.total, quoteMatchesCheckout: true }; }); assert.throws(() => submitOrder({ ...input, customer: { id: "", region: "local" } }), /Customer/); assert.throws(() => submitOrder({ ...input, items: [] }), /positive quantities/); console.log(JSON.stringify({ status: "passed", cases: results, invalidCustomerRejected: true, emptyCartRejected: true }, null, 2));
